purpose: Define explicit latency budgets and measurement boundaries for query, ingest, replication, changefeed and mutation paths without allowing performance goals to weaken semantic or governance requirements.

topics.name: DWH Latency Budget
topics.purpose: Define explicit latency budgets and measurement boundaries for query, ingest, replication, changefeed and mutation paths without allowing performance goals to weaken semantic or governance requirements.

semantics.budget_rule: Each latency budget has explicit start/end measurement boundaries and threshold/window.
semantics.measurement_rule: Queue, network, execution, validation and governance segments may be measured separately.
semantics.optimization_rule: Latency optimization cannot bypass validation, authorization, lineage, quality or consistency contracts.
semantics.timeout_rule: Timeout policy is explicit and distinct from successful completion.
semantics.partial_rule: Returning partial data to meet latency budget is allowed only under explicit partial-result policy.
semantics.clock_rule: Measurement clock/profile is explicit where cross-node timing affects evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Meeting latency target grants no authority.

invariants.rule: Freshness, availability, completeness, latency and SLO results are derived service-health evidence over exact data/runtime scopes; they never change data identity, ownership, classification, authorization or execution authority.

hard_gates.condition: timeout counted as successful low latency
security check skipped to meet budget
partial result returned as complete for speed

references.purpose: Query latency binds exact query execution.
